name: The window does one task
sees: The product's own window, already full, does the one job the page promises: a field fills, the list answers, the cursor presses the action, and the result lands as a change in the layout.
beats: a field fills (typed at 40-60 ms a letter) → the list filters or the panel opens → the cursor presses the action (a 2px press) → the result lands as a change in the layout (the row moves to Done by FLIP, the count ticks)
phone: One panel: the field and the list under it; the same four beats.

name: The agent works beside its result
sees: One line of request, the agent's own status line under it, and the work it changes beside it: each status names what it is doing to the rows the visitor can see.
beats: the request types in one line → the agent's line reads "Reading 412 entries" as the rows settle → "Checking against the bank feed" as an accent frame lands on one cell → "Fixed: a duplicate refund" as that cell rolls to the right figure and the total re-counts
phone: The request and the status line over the table, cropped to the rows that change.

name: The board moves its own card
sees: A board of real items in three or four columns: a new one arrives, the cursor carries one to the next column, and both counts change.
beats: a new item drops in at the top of column one (its count ticks) → the cursor lifts one item (accent left edge, 2° tilt) → carries it to the next column, which opens a slot while the old one closes → both counts tick and its status word changes
phone: Two columns of the board, the move between them.

name: Teammates take turns
sees: One shared object (a document, a plan, a design) and two or three named cursors, each making one change in turn.
beats: cursor "Ines" moves one block two places down (a note line under her name tag) → cursor "Agent" fills a missing figure → cursor "Tom" adds one comment → the object rests in its new state
phone: The object cropped to the blocks that change; the cursors' name tags stay.

name: Edit the source, the output rebuilds
sees: The source (a query, a formula, a config) beside the output it makes: one value changes in the source and the same marks in the output travel to their new places.
beats: the source line retypes one value ("last 30 days" → "last 90 days") → the output's marks travel to their new places (the same elements, FLIP) → the read-out re-counts ("1,240 rows → 3,912 rows · 0.4 s")
phone: The source line over the output, stacked.

name: A frame tours the live screen
sees: The whole screen of the product with three feature lines beside it: an accent frame steps from region to region, one value changes at each stop, and the matching line turns to full ink.
beats: a 2px accent frame steps (not glides) to region one and one value changes (38 → 41) → to region two, a status flips (Low → Ordered) → to region three, the total recalculates; the matching feature line beside the window turns full ink at each stop, and the lines are buttons that send the frame back
phone: The lines above the window; the frame steps the same way.
